name: IEF Bookkeeping
short_desc: Independent bookkeeping workflow with synthetic receipt review
author: EckPhi
description: Self-hosted workflow settings, synthetic bank movements, receipt allocation review and offline exports. Accounting destinations remain disconnected.

form_fields.label: Canonical application origin
form_fields.hint: Exact browser origin including scheme and optional port, with no trailing slash. Use the HTTPS Traefik domain when available. The application provides its own login.
form_fields.pattern_error: Enter an http:// or https:// origin without a path, trailing slash, query or credentials.

form_fields.label: GISA API key
form_fields.hint: Optional annually renewed key for Austrian GISA company-name and Firmenbuch-number lookups. VAT ID validation through EU VIES does not require it.
